weaknesses.what: At 2 seconds in, every panel just says 'waiting' with no live signal (e.g. audio level, partial word) that speech is actually being captured, so a first-time user has no way to confirm recording is working besides the static status text.
weaknesses.fix: Show a live mic/audio-level indicator or the first partial transcript fragment as soon as sound is detected, so the listening state feels verifiably active.

weaknesses.what: Four action buttons (リアルタイム要約, 質問する, 決定事項, アクション) are all disabled with nothing to act on yet, adding visual clutter without offering any usable function this early.
weaknesses.fix: Hide or visually de-emphasize these buttons until there is enough transcript/content for them to be meaningful.

weaknesses.what: The whole screen is gray/monochrome placeholder text with only a dotted animation for motion, giving no sense of the app being alive or responsive.
weaknesses.fix: Add a subtle accent color or micro-animation (e.g. a gentle pulse on the recording dot or a soft waveform) to make the listening state feel more alive.

weaknesses.what: Every content area (transcript, 決まったこと, やること, referenced materials) shows only placeholder 'waiting' text with no live signal that audio is truly being captured or understood.
weaknesses.fix: Add a small live audio-level meter or animated waveform next to 'マイク と 画面の音 を聞いています' so the user gets continuous visual proof of capture before any transcript appears.

weaknesses.what: The floating toolbar icons (comment bubble, expand, '…', stop) have no text labels, so their function is ambiguous on first viewing.
weaknesses.fix: Add hover tooltips or brief micro-labels under each icon in the floating toolbar.

weaknesses.what: The entire screen is functional but sterile — nothing signals life or progress beyond static placeholder sentences.
weaknesses.fix: Give the 'listening' state a subtle pulsing or breathing animation so the waiting period feels active rather than frozen.

weaknesses.what: Too many empty placeholder sections visible at launch (decisions, actions, summary). Wastes visual space and creates cognitive load.
weaknesses.fix: Hide or collapse empty sections in the early state. Introduce them only when content becomes available, or show a single status area instead.

weaknesses.what: 'AI が関わっている機能 — まだありません' is discouraging. Honest but pessimistic tone for a new user.
weaknesses.fix: Replace with encouraging language: 'AI features activate when speech is detected' or 'Ready to capture and analyze your meeting'.

weaknesses.what: Unclear what the user should do during recording. No guidance on whether to speak now, wait, or adjust anything.
weaknesses.fix: Add subtle instruction or status: 'Recording... speak naturally' or show a visual cue that recording is ready for input.

weaknesses.what: Right panel is largely empty; visual weight is unbalanced between left (content) and right (analysis panels).
weaknesses.fix: Either streamline the right panel to show only active elements, or move secondary controls elsewhere to avoid wasted space.
